on: The back panel comes off: three screws, a scorched wire, a dead switch.
spark: It sparks and stays dark. Another go.

fixed.fine: The cabinet coughs, flickers and lights up.
fixed.perfect: The cabinet lights up like new, and its music starts.

streak.one: The cabinet lights up gold, and stays lit for the day.
streak.run: Lit gold again. That makes {n} perfect repairs in a row.
